_comment: Canonical listing store. Statuses reflect VERIFICATION state. Nothing is status "match" unless its active status was read off a live MLS listing page (see README). The 2026-11-21 run gained direct access to MetroList MLS (metrolistpro.com), which is authoritative for El Dorado County and reports acreage and pool as structured fields.

dataQuality.source: MetroList MLS (metrolistpro.com) — the official search site of the MLS covering El Dorado County
dataQuality.note: Every property in "listings" was confirmed FOR SALE by loading its MLS listing-detail page. Acreage and pool come from structured MLS fields. Method validated against controls: MLS numbers for the six properties tracked in July all return "Listing Not Found", matching the user's report that they were off market.
dataQuality.coverageNote: MLS active counts at run time: Shingle Springs 22, Rescue 16, Placerville 145. A broker IDX site (century21.com) was cross-checked and found to omit 6 of the 6 qualifying Placerville properties, so broker IDX sites are not sufficient on their own.

listings.blurb: Cheapest way into the criteria by a wide margin, and nothing is compromised to get there: a full 5 acres, three full baths, a fenced in-ground pool with a generous patio, and no HOA. Built 1992, so systems are a generation newer than the other sub-$900K options.
